description: Shared quantitative circuit breaker parameters for PropWire terminal & cron runner.

messaging.stale_baseline_warning: Market line moved sharply vs opening quote. Model baseline may be stale; verify active news before trading.
messaging.beneficiary_oversteam_warning: Line moved beyond model target absorption capacity. Potential second-order news or book over-reaction.
messaging.high_edge_warning: Large edge (≥15%) on liquid book. May indicate stale projection or recent news; check status before acting.
messaging.stale_feed_warning: News watcher feed is stale (>5m). Automated alert dispatch is suppressed.
